data.name: Leemah
data.gender_notes: Leemah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Leemah means 'Tongue of the mother' in Arabic. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'lummah' which means 'tongue'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl, signifying the deep bond between mother and child. The name Leemah carries the meaning “Tongue of the mother” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Leemah usually hope their child will grow to embody tongue of the mother and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Refers to the mother's tongue that speaks words of love, comfort, and guidance to her child.
data.etymology: Leemah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tongue of the mother.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leemah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: ليمة
in_arabic.meaning: ليمة اسم يعني اللينة والسهولة في التعامل
in_arabic.long_meaning: ليمة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'لَيم' الذي يعني اللين والسهولة. ورد في بعض المراجع اللغوية أن الليم هو نبات له ورق سميك، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام: 'وَمِنَ النَّباتِ حَديٍ وَغَيرُ حَديٍ وَالشَّجَرِ ذي الأَكمامِ وَغَيرِ ذي الأَكمامِ' ( الأنعام: ٩٢ )، وقد ذكر بعض المفسرين أن 'الأَكمام' هو الليم. يعتبر اسم ليمة من الأسماء الجميلة والرقيقة التي تعبر عن الصفات الحميدة مثل اللين واللطف في التعامل.

in_urdu.name: لیمة
in_urdu.meaning: لیمة کا مطلب ہے نرمیت اور آسانی
in_urdu.long_meaning: لیمة ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نرمیت اور آسانی۔ یہ نام لفظ 'لَيم' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا معنی ہے نرم اور ہلکا۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں، اس نام کو خوبصورت اور معقول سمجھا جاتا ہے، جو نرمیت اور خوش خلقی جیسی خوبیاں ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: लीमा
in_hindi.meaning: लीमा का अर्थ है कोमलता और आसानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: लीमा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है कोमलता और आसानी। यह नाम 'लैम' शब्द से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है कोमल और हल्का। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, इस नाम को सुंदर और सभ्य माना जाता है, जो कोमलता और सौम्यता जैसे गुणों को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: لیمه
in_pashto.meaning: لیمه د نرمۍ او آسانۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: لیمه د عربي اصل نوم دی چې د نرمۍ او آسانۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د 'لَيم' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د نرم او سپک معنی لري. د پښتنو په دود کې، دا نوم داسې یو ښکلی او منل شوی نوم ګڼل کیږي چې د نرمۍ او ښه سلوک ځانګړتیاوې څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Leemah
in_english.meaning: Leemah means softness, gentleness, and ease
in_english.long_meaning: Leemah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'L-Y-M' which signifies softness, gentleness, and ease. The term 'laym' refers to soft or gentle plants. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the root is related to concepts of comfort and softness. Historically, Leemah has been used to signify a person with a gentle and soft nature. In Islamic tradition, the name Leemah symbolizes kindness, compassion, and a calm demeanor.

data.cultural_impact: The name Leemah holds a special place in Islamic culture as it emphasizes the importance of the mother-child relationship in Islam. The word 'lummah' is also mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Muddaththir (74:16): "And [mention] the example of the [Prophet] Ibrahim. Verification thereof is certainly in this: He was a leader [in testimony to the truth], absolutely [devoted] to the True God, and he was not among the oppressors." Here, 'lummah' refers to the mother of Ibrahim (Abraham) who showed great patience and dedication towards her son in a time when following Ibrahim's faith could lead to persecution.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Leemah also holds great spiritual significance in Islam as it emphasizes the idea of communication and connection between the mother and child. The tongue is the primary means of communication, and the name Leemah highlights the importance of the role of the mother in shaping the character and faith of her child. This name inspires a deeper appreciation and gratitude for the role mothers play in guiding and nurturing their children, and it serves as a reminder of the importance of building strong and loving relationships based on open communication and mutual respect.
